## Overview

Part of the [**Data Science Projects Collection**](https://github.com/PaulChanCyber/Data-Science-Project-) (Used Car Price Prediction)—Predicts used vehicle prices from mileage, year, brand, and condition features.

## Problem & Data

Used-car markets need transparent valuations from observable vehicle attributes.

## Approach

Listing scrape, feature engineering, ensemble/regression models, error analysis by segment.

## Technologies

Python · pandas · scikit-learn · Jupyter

## Outcomes

Price predictions with segment-level accuracy reporting.
